Built around five capabilities

  • SKHY2Lw T0¹ subscriptions and redemptions

Licensed Broker Custody

Licensed broker custody supports on- and off-chain reconciliation.

  • HK licensed-broker custody
  • On/off-chain holdings reconciliation

Top-Tier Liquidity

  • Integrated market making & quotes

RWA Structuring

  • Links assets & token rights

TradFi Investment Research

Research connects the asset thesis with the product mechanics.

  • Asset research & market analysis
  • Product mechanics & rationale

¹ SKHY2Lw: Primary subscriptions and redemptions are processed through approved participating dealers (PDs) for eligible professional investors.
